freeze_policy: Hash this file and all prompt fixtures before collecting model outputs; never overwrite raw runs.

independent_variables.backend_pair: At least two independently served, frozen model/version identifiers
independent_variables.seed: Provider seed when available; otherwise repeated stochastic trials

exclusions: Provider outage recorded before response generation
Truncated response proven by provider finish reason
Backend version differs from the frozen run manifest

analysis.interval: Wilson 95% confidence interval for every proportion
analysis.decision_rule: A property conforms only when its point estimate meets the threshold and its Wilson lower bound exceeds chance baseline.
analysis.multiplicity: Report all six properties; no composite success if any property fails.
analysis.missing_data: Count non-excluded parse failures as failures. Report exclusions separately.
